chunks: Abi (radhi Allahu 'anhu) from Sa'd ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali from al-Husayn ibn Jahm from Ibrahim ibn Mihrzam from a man who heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying:

Whoever recites 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' before meeting an unjust person, Allah will protect him from him by reciting it before him, behind him, to his right, and to his left. When he does that, Allah will grant him its good and protect him from its evil.
And he said: When you fear someone, recite a hundred verses from the Quran from wherever you wish, then say: 'O Allah, remove the calamity from me' three times.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method for spiritual protection against an unjust person according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal* highlights the esoteric power of Surah Al-Ikhlas as a comprehensive shield against the 'Jabbar' (the oppressive or tyrannical figure), recited in all four cardinal directions to create a spiritual perimeter. It further links this protection to the broader principle of seeking refuge through the Quran, prescribing the recitation of any hundred verses followed by a specific supplication to avert calamity, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Quran as both a textual and spiritual remedy.
